archetypes.name: strip-before-flag-eval
archetypes.rationale: drop_impure_empty_merge_attestation_lines runs before has_attest_line is evaluated, meaning padded attestation is absent when the new return-0 branch is reached, making the plan's padded-attest flip directive potentially a false-flip that breaks CI.
archetypes.prompt_body: In aggregate-findings.sh the Python heredoc calls drop_impure_empty_merge_attestation_lines(outtext) at line 502 before has_attest_line is evaluated at lines 529–531, so any padded attestation line is gone by the time the has_attest_line flag is set. Read the zero_findings_padded_attest_rejected fixture in test-aggregate-findings.sh to determine whether its attestation content is exclusively a padded line; if so, has_attest_line is False after the drop and the plan's new return-0 branch (which requires has_attest_line to be True) is never reached for this case. The plan's Files section says 'Same flip required' for the padded-attest test (line ~726), while its Edge Cases section says the case 'either (a) becomes ok or (b) becomes the no-attestation rejection' — these are contradictory directives when the fixture contains only a padded line. Determine which is correct: if padded-attest falls through to the no-attestation rejection branch (lines ~550–558), the current REASON=validation-exhausted assertion remains correct and should not be flipped, meaning the plan's Files section contains a false-flip that would fail CI. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: test-flip-inventory
archetypes.rationale: The plan's test-flip list omits the zero_findings test at lines ~578–593 of test-aggregate-findings.sh, which uses the same zero_findings stub with nonempty input and asserts REASON=validation-exhausted — the identical affected code path as zero_findings_input_nonempty.
archetypes.prompt_body: The plan identifies zero_findings_input_nonempty (~line 693), pattern-attest (~line 1196), and padded-attest (~line 726) as the only tests requiring attention, but the test block at lines ~578–593 of test-aggregate-findings.sh also uses AGGREGATE_STUB_MERGE_KIND=zero_findings against a copy of in3.md (three structured findings) and asserts REASON=validation-exhausted at line 591 — the identical stub and input path as zero_findings_input_nonempty. Verify whether this earlier test also feeds through empty_merge_from_nonempty_input in the validator and therefore also requires a flip to REASON=ok under the fix, which would mean the plan omits at least one assertion update. Additionally audit every REASON=validation-exhausted assertion in the file (lines ~591, ~726, ~1104, ~1119, ~1137, ~1196) to confirm which ones use a path that reaches the changed branch versus a path (preamble contradiction, no-attestation generic rejection) that is unaffected, and flag any that the plan's flip inventory misclassifies in either direction. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
